decision_rule.statement: Block the change when any case fails all 3 of its trials, or when the share of cases passing every trial falls below the lower bound of the Wilson 95% interval of the previous results for the same scope.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted a criterion whose "more than" had been flipped to "less than" as word for word.

cases.expected: The three criteria are copied word for word, with their comparisons ("more than", "or less") and amounts unchanged.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted a criterion cut short before its condition ("only when the item total is at least $20.00 and the coupon has not expired").

cases.expected: Both criteria are copied whole, the discount condition included; what the Analyst writes carries the coupon (pricing, a Red domain), so the runner holds the story to the full track, and any track the Analyst proposes is at least standard.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted an "Out of scope" line promoted to an acceptance criterion.

cases.expected: Only the two in-scope criteria are recorded; the out-of-scope price order is not a criterion.

source.description: The Gate 1 check once accepted a Jira comment promoted to an acceptance criterion.

cases.expected: The one criterion is recorded; the HTML comment and the product owner's comment are context, not criteria.

source.description: The Red-domain floor once missed every Spanish term. It reads what the Analyst writes as well as the story, so the Analyst must carry a Spanish payment story into its context word for word, where the runner finds the payment domain.

cases.expected: Both criteria are copied word for word in Spanish; what the Analyst writes carries the payment, so the runner holds the story to the full track, and any track the Analyst proposes is at least standard.

source.description: Bench Shop --bug stale-badge: the basket count does not go down on a take-out until the shopper changes screen (BENCH-1, RISK-001).

cases.expected: An automated case covers the basket count going down right after a take-out, without a change of screen, so a test can catch the stale count.

source.description: Bench Shop --bug wrong-item-total and --bug inconsistent-total: the review's Items figure is off by $1.00, or the Order total is not Items plus Sales tax (BENCH-2, RISK-001 and RISK-002).

cases.expected: Automated cases cover both the Items figure being the sum of the basket prices and the Order total being Items plus Sales tax.

checks.text: equals the exact sum of the prices

source.description: A price check written as a click on text=Items: $46.75 fails with Bench Shop --bug wrong-item-total; changing the figure to $47.75 makes it pass and hides a pricing bug.

cases.expected: The Healer declines: the app shows the wrong Items figure, which is a product bug for a bug draft, not a locator to repair.

source.description: A wait for the basket count to read 1 after a take-out fails with Bench Shop --bug stale-badge; waiting for 2, or for any count, makes it pass and hides the stale count.

cases.expected: The Healer declines: the basket count did not go down, which is the product bug the test exists to catch.

source.description: Control for the false-heal cases: a hook renamed by Bench Shop v2 (basket-add-<id> to put-in-<id>) is a genuine locator break, so a Healer that declines everything does not pass the set.

cases.expected: The Healer repairs the add-to-basket locator to the v2 hook with a change the guardrails accept, and leaves the basket-count assertion as it is. The evaluator checks the code; that the repair passes on v2 is not checked.

source.description: Planted in a faithful BENCH-2 spec: scenario 2 expects only that an "Items" figure is shown, where TC-002 expects it to equal the sum of the listed prices. A test written from it passes with Bench Shop --bug wrong-item-total.

cases.expected: The review raises the weakened expected outcome on TC-002 above info, and nothing above info about the other cases.

source.description: Planted in a faithful BENCH-2 spec: scenario 3 expects the Order total to equal the Items figure, dropping the Sales tax that TC-003 adds.

cases.expected: The review raises the expected outcome that contradicts TC-003 above info, and nothing above info about the other cases.

source.description: Planted in a faithful BENCH-2 spec: the scenario for TC-004, the only negative case (no postcode), is left out.

cases.expected: The review raises the approved TC-004 missing from the spec above info, and nothing above info about the other cases.

source.description: Control for the seeded spec cases: the faithful BENCH-2 spec, every approved case covered with its expected outcome. A reviewer that flags everything does not pass the set.

cases.expected: The review raises nothing above info.

source.description: Planted in a faithful BENCH-2 test: the TC-002 test checks only that the Items figure is a positive amount, never that it is the sum of the listed prices. It passes with Bench Shop --bug wrong-item-total.

cases.expected: The review raises the weak TC-002 assertion above info, and nothing above info about the other cases.

source.description: Planted in a faithful BENCH-2 test: the TC-005 test never checks that the basket count is cleared, one of the two results TC-005 expects.

cases.expected: The review raises the missing basket-count assertion on TC-005 above info, and nothing above info about the other cases.

source.description: Planted in a faithful BENCH-2 test: the test for TC-004, the only negative case (no postcode), is left out, though Gate 2 approved it as automate_e2e and the spec has its scenario.

cases.expected: The review raises TC-004 as not tested above info, and nothing above info about the other cases.

source.description: Control for the seeded test cases: the faithful BENCH-2 test, every approved case tested against its expected results. A reviewer that flags everything does not pass the set.

cases.expected: The review raises nothing above info.
